message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a weekday or is observed on a weekday, giving you at least three consecutive days off – Saturday, Sunday, and the holiday day.)

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Dates | Notes |
|---|---------|-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (​Sun) | Mon Jan 2 | Jan 1–3 | Observed on Monday because the actual holiday fell on a Sunday. |
| 2 | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, NB, PEI) | Feb 20 (Mon) | — | Feb 18–20 | Only in provinces that observe Family Day. |
| 3 | Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | — | Apr 7–9 | All provinces observe Good Friday. |
| 4 | Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | — | May 20–22 | All provinces observe Victoria Day. |
| 5 | Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | Mon Jul 3 | Jul 1–3 | Observed on Monday because the holiday fell on a Saturday. |
| 6 | Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | — | Sep 2–4 | All provinces observe Labour Day. |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | — | Oct 7–9 | All provinces observe Thanksgiving. |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Sat) | Mon Nov 13 | Nov 11–13 | Observed on Monday because the holiday fell on a Saturday. |
| 9 | Christmas | Dec 25 (Mon) | — | Dec 23–25 | All provinces observe Christmas. |
|10 | Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tue) | — | Dec 23–26 | Observed in most provinces; gives a four‑day stretch when combined with Christmas. |

### Quick Summary

| Year | Long‑Weekend Count (nationwide) | Key Observations |
|------|---------------------------------|------------------|
| 2023 | 10 (including Boxing Day) | 7 holidays that automatically give a long weekend (New Year’s, Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Remembrance Day, Christmas). Boxing Day adds a fourth day when combined with Christmas. |

> **Pro‑Tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, remember that *Family Day* and *Remembrance Day* are province‑specific. You might want to let users select their province so the app can filter the relevant long weekends.

Feel free to copy/paste this table into your app’s data source or UI. Let me know if you’d like the same information broken down by province or if you need additional details!
